assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Alan's Universe 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方／创作者：Alan 是谁？
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Alan's Universe 排名第 30 名/第 31 名，历史累计观看量约为 64B（640 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Alan's Universe 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER: Alan's Universe YouTube Channel

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UC5gxP-2QqIh_09djvlm9Xcg
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@AlanChikinChow
  • Also accessible via: https://www.youtube.com/c/Alanchikinchow
  • Vanity handle: @AlanChikinChow
  1. OPERATOR/CREATOR — WHO IS ALAN?
  • Alan Chikin Chow (born November 15, 1998)
  • American actor, digital creator, producer, writer, and influencer
  • Raised in Plano/Dallas, Texas; studied screenwriting and business administration at USC
  • Hollywood acting credits include Grey's Anatomy, Mean Girls (2024), One Piece (Netflix)
  • Signed with CAA (June 2024); named to Time's 100 influential creators (July 2025)
  • Describes his mission as 'unity through laughter' — positive, family-friendly comedy
  • Fanbase name: 'Alan Army'
  1. CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Channel created: February 3, 2020 (per Social Blade and YouTube's official 'About' metadata indexed by Google)
  • Note: Wikitubia/Fandom states February 2, 2020 — a one-day discrepancy with the platform's own recorded join date
  • First video was reportedly a reposted TikTok compilation (per Wikitubia)
  • First long-form video: '7 WEIRD Things Couples Do' uploaded May 30, 2020
  • Earliest still-public upload URL: NOT CONFIRMED — could not locate the specific video URL despite extensive search; the channel has 1,795+ videos and early content may have been removed or made private
  • Forbes interview quote: 'I started getting active on YouTube, reposting my videos in January 2022 and by February, was going viral'
  1. OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Displayed country: United States (confirmed by YouTube About page metadata, vidIQ, CreatorDB, OutlierKit)
  • Operating location: Burbank/Los Angeles, California — operates a 10,000 sq ft production studio opened in 2024
  • LinkedIn lists: 'Burbank, California, United States'
  1. LANGUAGES
  • English (posts in English per CreatorDB; audience is primarily English-speaking: US 53%, UK 18%, Philippines 18%, Canada 12% per OutlierKit)
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Comedy / Entertainment (Wikipedia genre classification)
  • More specifically: Teen Melodrama & High School Roleplay Skits (OutlierKit niche categorization)
  • Scripted short-form drama anthology series about high school life, love, friendship, and supernatural scenarios
  • Content described as a cross between a Disney Channel sitcom and K-drama Boys Over Flowers (Deadline)
  • Audience: 55% aged 13–17, 60% female-skewed, Gen Z and Gen Alpha
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
  • Team-based scripted production: uses a dedicated cast and crew at a 10,000 sq ft studio
  • High-volume, highly produced short-form content averaging 1–1.5 billion views per month
  • Production style: 'campy,' high-production-value, often wordless, fast-paced opening hooks designed for Gen Alpha attention spans (Forbes, NYT)
  • Initially repurposed TikTok content; evolved into original scripted narrative skits (Wikubia, Fortune)
  • Upload cadence varies by source: CreatorDB reports ~7.2 posts/week on YouTube; OutlierKit reports ~0.2 videos/week for long-form only — suggesting heavy reliance on Shorts with periodic long-form episodes
  • Recent shift toward longer format: ~98% of recent uploads are long-form averaging ~18:54 (OutlierKit)
  • Content strategy: ~90% evergreen tropes, ~10% trendjacking
  • Revenue streams: AdSense, brand sponsorships (Epic Games/Fortnite, Laneige, HYBE, Honkai: Star Rail), merchandise, expanded distribution on Roku, Amazon Prime, Tubi, and Netflix (day-and-date)
  1. REPRESENTATIVE WORKS (highest-viewing episodes)
  • 'No One Knew I Was a Famous Singer | Alan's Universe' — 95M views (vidIQ)
  • 'Boys vs Girls: Control The School | Alan's Universe' — 93M views (vidIQ/Mashable)
  • 'My Boyfriend is a Vampire!? | Alan's Universe' — 83M views (vidIQ)
  • 'Ugly Girl Becomes Beautiful Overnight | Alan's Universe' — 69M views (vidIQ)
  • 'My 7 Brothers Won't Let Me Date | Alan's Universe' — 69M views (vidIQ)
  • 'Who Murdered Alan Chikin Chow!?' — 19M views, ~5 months old (YouTube search results)
  • 'My Boyfriend Is a Werewolf?!' — 23M views, June 2025 (NYT)

KEY STATISTICS (as of September 2026):

  • Subscribers: ~102 million (#16–#17 globally, #1 Shorts creator)
  • Lifetime views: ~64 billion (matching the orchestrator's Communitrics snapshot)
  • Videos: 1,795+
  • Monthly views: ~1–1.5 billion average
